ctx.x: And Al Killian almost missed the boat, so -- Duke was kind of, you know, kind of [skimmish] about things like that -- he didn't know whether Al Killian was going to make it or not -- so he got Ernie Royal to come with us. So we had five trumpets on that trip in Europe.
